types_target.name: NoMoreDayTypes
admission_requirements: At least two intended architectural targets genuinely need the value type.
The owner is not Game-specific, App-specific, or render-resource-specific.
The type has stable value semantics without service, task, registry, graphics, or serialization lifetime.
The type changes rarely and is semantically cross-cutting.
Its public dependencies obey the same lower-layer boundary.
explicit_exclusions: save schemas, rendering resources, and SharedContext
